description: Source code for the TeleReporterEmitter class, which implements a test reporter for Playwright, handling test events and serializing them for external consumption.

classes.name: TeleReporterEmitter
classes.description: Implements a Playwright test reporter that emits test events and results via a message sink.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version string 'v2'.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Serializes and sends the test configuration.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Serializes and emits the beginning of the test suite.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Marks the start of a test and emits a 'onTestBegin' event.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles pausing of a test, records error count, and emits 'onTestPaused'.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Serializes and emits test end event, cleans up attachment/error counts.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Marks the start of a test step and emits 'onStepBegin'.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of a test step, serializes data, and emits 'onStepEnd'.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Emits an error event.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Handles stdout output during tests.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles stderr output during tests.

methods.name: _onStdIO
methods.description: Internal method to process stdio chunks and emit events.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Serializes and emits the full test run result.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates whether the reporter prints to stdio (returns false).

methods.name: _serializeConfig
methods.description: Serializes the full configuration object.

methods.name: _serializeProject
methods.description: Serializes a project suite into a JSON report.

methods.name: _serializeProjectUseOptions
methods.description: Serializes project 'use' options.

methods.name: _serializeSuite
methods.description: Serializes a test suite and its entries.

methods.name: _serializeTest
methods.description: Serializes a test case.

methods.name: _serializeResultStart
methods.description: Serializes the start state of a test result.

methods.name: _serializeResultEnd
methods.description: Serializes the end state of a test result.

methods.name: _sendNewAttachments
methods.description: Sends new attachments for a test result.

methods.name: _serializeAttachments
methods.description: Serializes test attachments, optionally base64-encoding bodies.

methods.name: _serializeStepStart
methods.description: Serializes the start of a test step.

methods.name: _serializeStepEnd
methods.description: Serializes the end of a test step.

methods.name: _relativeAnnotationLocations
methods.description: Converts annotation locations to relative paths.

methods.name: _relativeLocation
methods.description: Converts an absolute location to a relative one based on rootDir.

methods.name: _relativePath
methods.description: Converts an absolute file path to a path relative to rootDir.
